app_name.description: Name of the design prototype, shown as the page title and main heading.

placeholder_body.message: Placeholder page. Prototype pages arrive in later milestones.
placeholder_body.description: Explains that this page is temporary and will be replaced by real prototype pages.

placeholder_locale.description: Shows which language the page is currently displayed in.

popup_title.description: Name shown in the popup header.

popup_history.description: Header link that opens the History page.

popup_page_heading.description: Heading of the list of media found on the current page.

popup_untitled.description: Shown when a detected item has no title.

popup_duration_unknown.description: Shown instead of the duration when it is not known.

popup_duration_live.description: Label for a live broadcast, in place of the duration.

popup_btn_download.description: Saves the item with the default choices.

popup_btn_record.description: Starts recording a live item with the default choices.

popup_btn_choices.description: Opens the quality, audio and subtitle choices of an item.

popup_btn_cancel.description: Cancels a download and discards what was saved.

popup_btn_stop.description: Ends a live recording and keeps what was recorded. Different from Cancel.

popup_btn_dismiss.description: Removes a finished or failed download from the list.

popup_btn_back.description: Returns to the previous view of the popup.

popup_btn_more_jobs.description: Opens the item view when an item has more downloads than the row can show.

popup_protected_label.message: Protected: Servare cannot save this one.

popup_protected_why.message: The site protects this video, and Servare does not get around protections.

popup_status_waiting.message: Waiting for another download from this site
popup_status_waiting.description: Status of a download waiting for another one from the same site.

popup_status_running_size.description: Progress of a running download whose total size is unknown.

popup_status_paused_live.description: Status of a paused live recording.

popup_status_failed.description: Short status of a failed download.

popup_status_done.description: Short status of a finished download.
